decisionTitle: Uses actual cli.js behavior for --out (writes to both stdout and file) instead of task text's 'file instead of stdout' wording
rationale: cli.js (from task 11) always writes the result to stdout and additionally writes to --out if given, rather than redirecting output away from stdout. The task instructions explicitly say to determine behavior from the real sources rather than assume, so test/cli.test.js asserts this actual dual-write behavior (stdout still gets the result, file also receives it) rather than the 'written to file, not stdout' phrasing in the task description. Also found that test/cli.test.js already existed with strong coverage of all 7 modes (upper/lower/title/camel/pascal/snake/kebab from lib.js MODES), --help/-h, invalid --mode, stdin fallback, --out, and a no-network-require check; I only extended the forbidden-require regex to explicitly include net/dgram/tls alongside the already-covered http/https/dns/fetch, per the task's exact module list.
